Here is a literature review on the topic:

Scammers continually adapt and evolve their tactics, leveraging advanced technologies to evade detection (Katz, 2019). To counter these threats, individuals and organizations must adopt proactive measures, such as implementing robust security protocols and educating users about emerging scams (Harrison, 2020). By staying informed and vigilant, individuals can better protect themselves against these threats, while organizations can develop effective countermeasures to mitigate the impact of scams (Kumar, 2018).

References:

Harrison, A. (2020). The Evolution of Scams in the Digital Age. Journal of Cybersecurity, 10(1), 1-12.

Katz, R. (2019). Scammers' Tactics and Strategies in the Digital Age. Journal of Forensic Accounting, 21(2), 147-162.

Kumar, N. (2018). Protecting Against Scams in the Digital Era. International Journal of Cyber Security, 12(3), 257-272.
